capabilities: Track note creation and modification activity across the vault
Display streak stats and weekly, monthly, yearly, and all-time trend charts
Drill down from chart points to lists of matching notes
Configure streak conditions, frontmatter date keys, and folder include/exclude filters
Toggle metrics between new notes and modified notes
extras: The README warns that Obsidian only exposes the current modified time of files, so the dashboard reflects each note's latest known activity rather than a full per-edit history. Data is stored locally with no external analytics or sync.
motivation: The author built it to make note capture and maintenance visible, specifically to keep collecting and refining in balance in Zettelkasten-style systems.
problem: Obsidian gives no visibility into whether you are actually revisiting and updating existing notes or just collecting new ones, so an imbalance like over-collecting fleeting notes goes unnoticed.
summary: Activity dashboard plugin that tracks note creation and modification streaks and trends, with drill-down lists of the notes behind each chart point.
